agent_gap_texts_check.name: agent_gap_texts_check
agent_gap_texts_check.value: char_length(btrim("agent_gap"."question")) between 3 and 200 and char_length("agent_gap"."question_key") between 1 and 200

agent_gap_closed_check.name: agent_gap_closed_check
agent_gap_closed_check.value: ("agent_gap"."outcome" is null) = ("agent_gap"."closed_at" is null) and ("agent_gap"."outcome" is null) = ("agent_gap"."closed_by" is null) and ("agent_gap"."outcome" is null or outcome IN ('respondida','quitada'))

cash_handover_note_check.name: cash_handover_note_check
cash_handover_note_check.value: ("cash_handover"."note" is null or char_length(btrim("cash_handover"."note")) between 3 and 300) and ("cash_handover"."received_cents" = "cash_handover"."expected_cents" or "cash_handover"."note" is not null)

contract_outbox_pending_idx.name: contract_outbox_pending_idx
contract_outbox_pending_idx.where: sent_at is null and rejected_at is null

contract_outbox_rejected_check.name: contract_outbox_rejected_check
contract_outbox_rejected_check.value: "contract_outbox"."rejected_at" is null or ("contract_outbox"."sent_at" is null and "contract_outbox"."type" = 'pago.comprobante')

conversation_texts_check.name: conversation_texts_check
conversation_texts_check.value: ("conversation"."customer_name" is null or char_length(btrim("conversation"."customer_name")) between 1 and 120) and ("conversation"."waiting_reason" is null or char_length(btrim("conversation"."waiting_reason")) between 3 and 200)

conversation_message_delivery_check.name: conversation_message_delivery_check
conversation_message_delivery_check.value: ("conversation_message"."delivery" is null or delivery IN ('prueba','sin_enviar')) and (("conversation_message"."author" = 'cliente') = ("conversation_message"."delivery" is null))

conversation_message_follow_check.name: conversation_message_follow_check
conversation_message_follow_check.value: ("conversation_message"."follow_up" is null) = ("conversation_message"."follow_up_ref" is null) and ("conversation_message"."follow_up" is null or (follow_up IN ('pago','gracias','volvio','volver') and "conversation_message"."author" = 'sofi'))

customer_texts_check.name: customer_texts_check
customer_texts_check.value: char_length(btrim("customer"."name")) between 1 and 120 and ("customer"."phone" is null or char_length("customer"."phone") between 1 and 30) and char_length("customer"."note") <= 1000

order_payment_texts_check.name: order_payment_texts_check
order_payment_texts_check.value: ("order_payment"."operation" is null or char_length("order_payment"."operation") between 1 and 60) and ("order_payment"."note" is null or char_length("order_payment"."note") <= 300)

order_payment_photo_check.name: order_payment_photo_check
order_payment_photo_check.value: ("order_payment"."photo" is null) = ("order_payment"."photo_type" is null) and ("order_payment"."photo_type" is null or photo_type IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')) and ("order_payment"."photo" is null or octet_length("order_payment"."photo") between 1 and 1500000)

product_category_check.name: product_category_check
product_category_check.value: "product"."category" is null or char_length(btrim("product"."category")) between 1 and 60

push_device_keys_check.name: push_device_keys_check
push_device_keys_check.value: char_length("push_device"."endpoint") between 10 and 1000 and char_length("push_device"."p256dh") between 1 and 200 and char_length("push_device"."auth") between 1 and 100

sale_order_customer_check.name: sale_order_customer_check
sale_order_customer_check.value: char_length(btrim("sale_order"."customer_name")) between 1 and 120 and ("sale_order"."customer_phone" is null or char_length("sale_order"."customer_phone") <= 30) and char_length("sale_order"."address") <= 300 and char_length("sale_order"."notes") <= 500

sale_order_amounts_check.name: sale_order_amounts_check
sale_order_amounts_check.value: "sale_order"."delivery_cents" between 0 and "sale_order"."delivery_list_cents" and "sale_order"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "sale_order"."discount_cents" >= 0 and "sale_order"."gift_cents" >= 0 and "sale_order"."total_cents" = "sale_order"."subtotal_cents" + "sale_order"."delivery_cents" - "sale_order"."return_credit_cents" and "sale_order"."margin_used_cents" between 0 and "sale_order"."margin_cents"

sale_order_exchange_check.name: sale_order_exchange_check
sale_order_exchange_check.value: "sale_order"."return_credit_cents" >= 0 and ("sale_order"."exchange_of_id" is not null or "sale_order"."return_credit_cents" = 0) and ("sale_order"."exchange_of_id" is null or "sale_order"."exchange_of_id" <> "sale_order"."id")

sale_order_cancel_check.name: sale_order_cancel_check
sale_order_cancel_check.value: ("sale_order"."state" = 'anulado') = ("sale_order"."cancel_reason" is not null) and ("sale_order"."cancel_reason" is null or char_length(btrim("sale_order"."cancel_reason")) between 3 and 300)

sale_order_tracking_check.name: sale_order_tracking_check
sale_order_tracking_check.value: "sale_order"."tracking" is null or char_length("sale_order"."tracking") between 1 and 80

sale_order_slot_check.name: sale_order_slot_check
sale_order_slot_check.value: ("sale_order"."slot_start" is null) = ("sale_order"."slot_end" is null) and ("sale_order"."slot_start" is null or ("sale_order"."slot_start" >= 0 and "sale_order"."slot_start" < "sale_order"."slot_end" and "sale_order"."slot_end" <= 1440))

sale_order_agency_check.name: sale_order_agency_check
sale_order_agency_check.value: "sale_order"."agency" is null or char_length(btrim("sale_order"."agency")) between 1 and 60

sale_order_line_price_check.name: sale_order_line_price_check
sale_order_line_price_check.value: "sale_order_line"."floor_unit_cents" <= "sale_order_line"."auto_unit_cents" and "sale_order_line"."auto_unit_cents" <= "sale_order_line"."list_unit_cents" and (case when "sale_order_line"."gift" then "sale_order_line"."unit_cents" = 0 else "sale_order_line"."unit_cents" between "sale_order_line"."floor_unit_cents" and "sale_order_line"."auto_unit_cents" end)

stock_movement_sign_check.name: stock_movement_sign_check
stock_movement_sign_check.value: case "stock_movement"."kind" when 'entrada' then "stock_movement"."quantity" > 0 when 'anulacion' then "stock_movement"."quantity" > 0 when 'devolucion' then "stock_movement"."quantity" > 0 when 'venta' then "stock_movement"."quantity" < 0 else "stock_movement"."quantity" <> 0 end

stock_movement_reason_check.name: stock_movement_reason_check
stock_movement_reason_check.value: ("stock_movement"."kind" not in ('ajuste','devolucion') or char_length(btrim(coalesce("stock_movement"."reason", ''))) >= 3) and ("stock_movement"."reason" is null or char_length("stock_movement"."reason") <= 300)

stock_movement_reference_check.name: stock_movement_reference_check
stock_movement_reference_check.value: ("stock_movement"."kind" in ('venta','anulacion','devolucion')) = ("stock_movement"."reference" is not null) and ("stock_movement"."reference" is null or char_length("stock_movement"."reference") between 1 and 80)

store_public_name_check.name: store_public_name_check
store_public_name_check.value: "store"."public_name" is null or char_length(btrim("store"."public_name")) between 1 and 80

store_agent_texts_check.name: store_agent_texts_check
store_agent_texts_check.value: ("store_agent"."display_name" is null or char_length(btrim("store_agent"."display_name")) between 1 and 60) and char_length("store_agent"."knowledge") <= 2000

store_agent_choices_check.name: store_agent_choices_check
store_agent_choices_check.value: tone IN ('cercana','formal','directa') and address IN ('tu','usted') and emojis IN ('ninguno','pocos') and ("store_agent"."handoff_over_cents" is null or "store_agent"."handoff_over_cents" > 0)

store_delivery_method_price_check.name: store_delivery_method_price_check
store_delivery_method_price_check.value: ("store_delivery_method"."cost" = 'fijo') = ("store_delivery_method"."price_cents" is not null) and ("store_delivery_method"."price_cents" is null or "store_delivery_method"."price_cents" >= 0)

store_delivery_method_deal_check.name: store_delivery_method_deal_check
store_delivery_method_deal_check.value: ("store_delivery_method"."max_discount_cents" is null and "store_delivery_method"."free_from_cents" is null) or "store_delivery_method"."cost" in ('fijo','por_zona')

store_delivery_method_deal_amounts_check.name: store_delivery_method_deal_amounts_check
store_delivery_method_deal_amounts_check.value: ("store_delivery_method"."max_discount_cents" is null or "store_delivery_method"."max_discount_cents" > 0) and ("store_delivery_method"."free_from_cents" is null or "store_delivery_method"."free_from_cents" > 0)

store_invitation_pending_idx.name: store_invitation_pending_idx
store_invitation_pending_idx.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

store_invitation_closed_check.name: store_invitation_closed_check
store_invitation_closed_check.value: ("store_invitation"."accepted_at" is null or "store_invitation"."accepted_by" is not null) and ("store_invitation"."revoked_at" is null or "store_invitation"."revoked_by" is not null) and ("store_invitation"."accepted_at" is null or "store_invitation"."revoked_at" is null)

store_support_access_answer_check.name: store_support_access_answer_check
store_support_access_answer_check.value: ("store_support_access"."state" = 'pedido') = ("store_support_access"."answered_at" is null) and ("store_support_access"."answered_at" is null) = ("store_support_access"."answered_by" is null) and ("store_support_access"."expires_at" is not null) = ("store_support_access"."state" in ('aceptado','quitado') and "store_support_access"."answered_at" is not null) and ("store_support_access"."state" = 'quitado') = ("store_support_access"."ended_at" is not null)
